offering_description.value: Owns and operates bowling-based entertainment venues offering bowling, arcade games, food and beverages, and event hosting for consumers and groups. Also runs a professional bowling league and owns Bowlero, Lucky Strike and AMF-branded centers.

primary_products.value: food and beverages; alcoholic beverages; arcade games

primary_services.value: bowling; event hosting; amusement and arcade play; professional bowling league media

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, leagues, casual groups and individual bowlers; B2B: corporate events, parties and sponsors

end_markets.value: location-based entertainment; food and beverage; sports media

revenue_model.value: service fees: bowling, league and lane rental fees; product sales: food, beverages and arcade games; advertising: sponsorships and media rights for professional bowling; project or contract: corporate and private event bookings
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; advertising; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates bowling centers serving consumers and groups; brand owner: owns Bowlero, Lucky Strike and Professional Bowlers Association brands

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with centers also in Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: bowling centers, food and beverage, arcade games and professional bowling media

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned bowling entertainment venues; online: online lane, party and event reservations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: alcohol licensing, food safety, health and safety, and labor rules from state and local authorities
